hook: SCP-058 is a short creature file about a cow's heart that walks on insect legs, lashes spined tentacles and carries a stinger. Its most unusual feature is not a weapon at all but its voice, so give the interview at the end your full attention.
whyItMatters: The file stacks up hard numbers: a cube cell with metres of steel and concrete, a live cow every three days, on-site nuclear weapons as the fallback, and a body count of 149 D-class plus 14 agents at its current site alone. Against that brutal tally it sets a calm old British man's voice that never stops talking. That clash between a hunting organ and a soft, rambling narrator is what makes the creature stick.
thingsToNotice: The thirty-minute listening limit in the procedures quietly warns you that the voice is a hazard before the transcript ever appears. The report says the speech has no link to what is happening around it, yet the lines are thick with hearts, blood, children and flaying, so you keep hunting for sense the file says is not there. In the log, D-067 starts to joke about how creepy it is, breaks off into screaming, and the screaming simply stops while the creature's sentence rolls on at the same pace and Dr. Johnston's plea to let him go is ignored. The breach history is equally blunt: it burns most of a nearby town with sprayed stinger fluid, is stopped once by collapsing masonry and again by an agent driving an M1 tank over it.

related.note: The addendum says its containment team saw SCP-1175-2 grow agitated on dates matching SCP-058's long breaches.
